summary: Accurate and fun for basketball fans, but too hard for a daily: the famous guesses (Shaq, Rodman, LeBron) all miss, and Elvin Hayes and Robert Parish are fan-only names.
reasons: Casual: Wilt, Russell, Kareem, Duncan, Howard and Garnett for 6/10, then out of lives on guess 12 (Shaq #15, Rodman #24, LeBron #23, Yao Ming, Barkley #19). A real casual does worse.
Most non-fans can't name five of the top 10, so it misses the daily bar. Fans clear it: 10/10 in 13 guesses, losing Shaq, Hakeem and Rodman.
Good as a Blitz, where those famous big men score: 15 of 22 casual names scored (Kobe, Giannis, Jokic and Embiid score nothing).
fixes: Junk redirect aliases on ranks 11+: LeBron James 'Gloria James' (his mother), "Bronny's dad", 'LRMR' (his company); Dirk Nowitzki 'Silke Nowitzki', 'Helga Nowitzki', 'Helga Bredenbröcker' (sister, mother); Shaquille O'Neal 'Joe Toney', 'Joseph Toney' (his father), "Shaq's Size". Drop redirects that name relatives, companies or article sections.
